item.title: Aligned inclusions can create a cat’s-eye effect in gems
item.description:
GEMOLOGY FACT: A narrow line can appear when light reflects from aligned needle-like inclusions in a gemstone. A rounded cabochon and the orientation of its base help the effect show.
EXIMUTC view: Examine the line’s sharpness and movement in person; a photograph alone should not decide identity or quality.
Source: www.gia.edu https://www.gia.edu/gems-gemology/winter-2021-lab-notes-color-zoned-cats-eye-chrysoberyl

item.title: Color zoning affects the appearance of amethyst
item.description:
GEMOLOGY FACT: The purple color in amethyst may be distributed unevenly, influencing the appearance of the cut gem.
EXIMUTC view: Inspect face-up color zoning rather than judging only by weight.
Source: Gemological Institute of America https://www.gia.edu/amethyst-quality-factor
